title: Provenance
beats: A German survey column, nine days|in a dry riverbed behind the line.
They are not digging anything up.|They brought something with them.
Bill of sale, export licence, and proof|it was looted from this valley in 1811.
!They are putting it back,|and they are entirely within their rights.
